title: Prefix public and admin routes with /echofields

requirements.summary: Move all public clue/progress routes and admin management routes under an /echofields base path while preserving URL-based progression and keeping admin protected by Internet Identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting a public clue URL under the "echofields" base path (e.g., /echofields/<clue-id>) renders the same clue content that would otherwise be shown for that clue.
Admin pages are reachable under a route that includes "echofields" and still require Internet Identity authentication for admin actions.
No public clue/progress pages are exposed at the old top-level routes if they would omit "echofields" (either redirect to the new routes or only register the new routes).

file_operations.description: Implement the app's route table so that all public clue/progress routes and all admin routes are registered under the "/echofields" base path (e.g., "/echofields/:clueId", "/echofields/progress", "/echofields/admin"). Preserve the existing URL-param driven clue/progress behavior by keeping the same route params and route-to-view mapping, just nested beneath the new base path. Ensure old top-level public routes that omit "echofields" are not exposed by either not registering them or by redirecting them to the corresponding "/echofields/..." route.

Add a small route-guard wrapper for admin routes that uses the existing Internet Identity hook (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts) to require an authenticated identity before rendering admin management UI, and otherwise prompts the user to log in. Wire this guard into the admin route branch under "/echofields/admin".

Update the app bootstrap to ensure the new App router (with the "/echofields" base path and any legacy-route redirects) is the single routing entry point used by the application, so old top-level public clue/progress URLs do not remain reachable.
